sloka: अथ तस्य निनादम् तम् सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।शुश्राव अन्तःपुर गतो वाली भ्रातुर् अमर्षणः ॥४-१५-१॥
transliteration: atha tasya ninādam tam sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।śuśrāva antaḥpura gato vālī bhrātur amarṣaṇaḥ ॥4-15-1॥

translations.english: The indignant Vali, who was in the harem, heard the roaring of his venerable brother, Sugriva.
